name: ocd_v0p4_8v18v
description: OCD-style overdrive v0.4: S002-verified topology + user node connections; 8-18V DC center-negative, 9V nominal. D_FB_FIX moves C4/C8 in series with R5/R11 (the prior parallel placement saturated both op-amps). Adds 1N5819 protection, status LED, 9V battery/DC-jack provision, and an explicit HP/LP SW1. Not a verified Fulltone netlist; 2N7000/1N34A/1N5819 models are approximations.

supplies.name: VCC_JACK
supplies.source: 8-18V DC center-negative at the jack; 9V nominal test; VCC after 1N5819 protection; VCC_F after R1 filter

assumptions: S002 topology; S003 cross-check; S001/S013 context; not a verified Fulltone netlist.
TL082 vendor model; 2N7000/1N34A/1N5819/LED/SW models are approximations or ideal. The models gate is SKIP.
Pots are modeled as 50% linear snapshots; actual tapers/values are unverified.
HP/LP is modeled as a voltage-controlled SW1; the physical part is an SPDT and PCB mapping is Phase C.
Battery/DC-jack/3PDT wiring is not simulated; it is bench/PCB Phase C.
AC excitation is split into V_IN and V_AC; THD/noise are exploratory.

requirements.text: Operate from 8-18V DC center-negative at the jack with series reverse-polarity protection; the protected/filtered rail VCC_F must keep the TL082 within its 7-30V total-supply range.
requirements.acceptance: At 8V jack, VCC_F >= 7.0V; at 18V jack, VCC_F <= 30V; reverse polarity draws no current and causes no damage (current-limited test).

requirements.text: Vref = VCC_F/2 within +/-5% at 8/9/18V and stable under signal.
requirements.acceptance: Measured VREF 3.59/4.04/7.95V nominal at 8/9/18V, +/-5%; no shift or oscillation under drive.

requirements.text: Both TL082 stages have unity DC gain and no quiescent saturation.
requirements.acceptance: X1_OUT ~= X1_P and X3_OUT ~= X3_P; neither output at a rail at 8/9/18V.

requirements.text: SW1 selects R14 only (LP, darker) or R14 in parallel with R15 (HP, brighter).
requirements.acceptance: Repeatable HP/LP frequency-response difference at 1kHz with Drive/Tone/Volume fixed; no oscillation. Parallel position is brighter per S003.

requirements.text: Status LED with series resistor from VCC_F to GND, 1-5mA at 8-18V.
9V battery option with a switching DC jack and input-jack battery disconnect.
requirements.acceptance: Battery disconnects when the DC plug is inserted; no battery drain when the input jack is unplugged.

requirements.text: True bypass with a 3PDT; dry signal passes when off.
requirements.acceptance: Continuity/audio check; active circuit isolated when off.

requirements.text: PCB-mounted 1/4-inch TS jacks and 3PDT; 1590B enclosure, 108 x 58mm board, through-hole (Phase C).

decisions.decision: 8-18V DC center-negative at the jack; 9V nominal test.
decisions.rationale: User intake; TL082 total-supply maximum is 30V (S007).

decisions.decision: Clip network M1/M2/D1 wiring per the S002 schematic image.
decisions.rationale: The image confirms M1[D&G=VREF,S=CLIP_A], M2[D=VREF,G&S=M2_D1_NODE], D1[A=CLIP_A,K=M2_D1_NODE].

decisions.decision: X2 Drive 1M audio, X5 Volume 100k audio provisional, X4 Tone 10k audio wired as a rheostat in series with C11 to ground; 50% linear snapshot in simulation.
decisions.rationale: S002 gives the pot values and confirms X4 sends treble through the 10k pot and C11 to ground. Tapers and the X5 value are unverified.

decisions.decision: TL082 vendor model; 2N7000/1N34A project approximations; 1N5819/LED/SW ideal models.
decisions.rationale: Only the TL082 has a vendor macromodel; the rest are simulation-only approximations and the models gate is SKIP.

decisions.decision: Keep R2 to GND, R6 to VREF, and D1 as 1N34A; do not add a second Ge diode.
decisions.rationale: S002 text and image confirm this bias arrangement.

decisions.decision: Tone/HP-LP: R14 22k always in path; R15 33k in parallel only when SW1 is closed (HP); SW1 open = LP.
decisions.rationale: S002 confirms R14/R15 values. S003 states the switch-on position parallels R12/R13 (R14/R15 here) reducing high-frequency loss, i.e. brighter; AGENTS.md defines HP as brighter/more presence. So HP=closed/parallel, LP=open. Reverses the provisional D_TONE label.

decisions.decision: Move C4 in series with R5 (X1_FB -> X1_RG -> VREF) and C8 in series with R11 (X3_FB -> X3_RG -> VREF).
decisions.rationale: The prior parallel placement gave zero DC feedback and saturated both op-amps. Series placement gives unity DC gain and the intended AC bass limit. 8/9/18V OP after the fix: VREF 3.588/4.039/7.947V; X1_OUT 2.441/2.747/5.406V; X3_OUT 2.538/2.857/5.905V.

decisions.decision: 1N5819 series Schottky reverse-polarity protection; P-FET fallback if the 8V margin fails.
decisions.rationale: Simple and low-drop. At 8V jack the TL082 sees about 7.7V real (about 7.25V with the pessimistic model), leaving roughly 0.7V above the 7V minimum; bench gate.

decisions.decision: LED + 4.7k from VCC_F to GND; always-on in simulation; physically switched by the 3PDT.
9V battery via a switching DC jack and input-jack battery disconnect.
decisions.rationale: User requirement; prevents battery drain when unplugged.

decisions.decision: Split V_IN (SIN) and V_AC (AC 1V) in series because the generator drops AC when a waveform is present.
decisions.rationale: AC metrics need excitation while transient needs a sine. Verified AC gain at 1kHz/9V after the fix: OUT 37.2dB, X1_OUT 43.1dB, X3_OUT 54.5dB.

decisions.decision: Use datasheet TL082 limits for headroom and the vendor model for AC/clipping shape; model supply current is not trustworthy.
decisions.rationale: The TL082 model draws 8.4mA at 9V and 16.6mA at 18V vs about 2.8mA real, inflating the R1 drop.

decisions.decision: 1590B enclosure, 108 x 58mm board, through-hole, PCB-mounted I/O jacks and 3PDT (Phase C).
decisions.rationale: User decision; PCB work is deferred.
The old netlist had C4/C8 in parallel (saturated bias) and V_IN without an AC magnitude (zero AC excitation).

architecture.summary: VCC_JACK -> D_PWR(1N5819) -> VCC -> R1/C2/C3 -> VCC_F; Vref divider; input C1/R2/R6/R3; X1 gain (R5+C4 series, R8/Drive, C6); clip R9/C7/R10/R12/M1/M2/D1; X3 gain (R11+C8 series, R13, C9); tone/HP-LP (R14/R15/SW1); volume; LED; true bypass.

supplies.name: VCC_F
supplies.note: Filtered op-amp rail after R1; model current makes this pessimistic; real ~8.4V at 9V

budgets.headroom: +/-2.09V at 8V, +/-2.54V at 9V, +/-6.45V at 18V (TL082 typ 1.5V rail headroom; model VCC_F)
budgets.supply_current: TL082 model 8.4mA at 9V, 16.6mA at 18V; datasheet 2.8mA typ

risks.risk: TL082 CM/swing/headroom may be insufficient at 8V single supply (condition/process/temperature dependent)
risks.mitigation: Verify SLOS081O limits (S007) + provenance-tracked SPICE/bench at 8/9/18V; substitute only with datasheet/SPICE provenance and a recorded decision (D002)

risks.risk: 1N34A Ge diode variability shifts clipping symmetry/threshold
risks.mitigation: Select/measure diodes or design for tolerance; D003 allows BAT46/1N4148 options with provenance

risks.risk: Exact schematic values/orientation not a verified Fulltone netlist
risks.mitigation: Hybrid working reference S002+S003 cross-checked with S001/S013; label unverified items; confirm pin-level values/orientation against traceable schematic+datasheets before fabrication

risks.risk: 1N5819 drop plus the TL082 7V minimum leaves only about 0.7V at an 8V jack
risks.mitigation: Bench-gate 8V operation; fall back to a P-FET reverse-polarity circuit if the margin fails

risks.risk: The TL082 model supply current is about 3-6x the datasheet value, so simulated VCC_F/headroom is pessimistic
risks.mitigation: Use datasheet limits for headroom decisions; record the model artifact

risks.risk: PCB-mounted 3PDT/jack mechanical alignment and the SW1 physical SPDT mapping are unproven
risks.mitigation: Phase C mechanical fit check in a 1590B; confirm footprint pad positions and switch mapping before fabrication

risks.risk: X2/X5 values, wiring and tapers are unverified.
risks.mitigation: Confirm against a traceable schematic/photo; mark the 50% linear simulation snapshot.

risks.risk: The voltage-controlled SW1 model has four nodes but the physical HP/LP switch is a three-terminal SPDT.
risks.mitigation: Define the physical pad mapping in Phase C; keep the control pins simulation-only.

risks.risk: AC/THD/noise metrics are exploratory; there is no verified reference target.
risks.mitigation: Record conditions and model provenance; do not claim a verified clone performance.
